title: Image generation gets an MCP server
summary:
Assistants gained image-generation tools, while the text API learned to parse a reasoning-effort setting.

Added an MCP server for assistants such as Claude. Its tools create image URLs, fetch images as base64, and list available image models. Generation accepts a prompt with optional model, seed, width, and height.

The text API parser now extracts `reasoning_effort` from requests. Documentation describes `low`, `medium`, and `high` for `openai-reasoning` (o3-mini); the supplied change does not establish that the value reaches the model provider.

Renamed the MCP package and command to `pollinations-model-context-protocol`, updated setup instructions, and added interface screenshots. The audio documentation also gained a link for exploring voices.

highlights.title: Images through MCP
highlights.text: Assistants such as Claude can use MCP tools to create image URLs, fetch images, and list image models. Generation supports optional model, seed, and size settings. [Explore the MCP docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).
